newsitem.title: USA: Cablevision may be target of FCC complaint.
newsitem.headline: Cablevision may be target of FCC complaint.

text.p: Classic Sports Network said on Monday that it intends to file a complaint with the Federal Communications Commission against Cablevision Systems Corp, alleging violations of the 1992 Cable Act.

Classic Sports, a television network that features highlights from sports history, alleges that the cable operator has attempted to coerce the sports television network into granting an ownership interest or exclusive distribution rights.
Cablevision was not immediately available for comment.

Classic Sports said Cablevision has denied the channel any distribution in the New York and Connecticut markets until it agreed to provide them either exclusivity in certain regions or equity ownership.
A Cablevision spokesman said the company will issue a response later today.
Classic Sports is mostly owned by Allen & Co, AT&T Ventures, Wayne Huizenga, Warburg Pincus Ventures LP.
